editorial:
You follow a group of neighborhood teens who all start having the same nightmare about a badly burned man in a striped sweater with a glove full of knives. At first it feels like a bad dream, but when one of them dies in real life, the rest realize their dreams are deadly. The movie keeps you on edge as the friends try to stay awake while figuring out who this man is and why he is after them. It is a dark and tense ride from start to finish.

The remake leans hard on jump scares and dark visuals, and Jackie Earle Haley brings a creepy new take on Freddy. The pacing is quick, though some scenes feel rushed and the characters are not very deep. If you enjoy modern horror with lots of tension, you will have a good time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Nancy and Quentin track down Freddy's old workplace and learn he was a child killer who was burned alive by angry parents. They pull him into the real world and kill him, but Freddy is not truly gone. In the last moment, Freddy's glove bursts through Nancy's mother's chest, showing he still haunts them. It is a dark twist that leaves you wondering if anyone is ever safe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves modern slasher horror and creepy villains.
